spec: BiasAperture — 20-track parallel research sprint (Claude Desktop, 20 users) to unblock WP2-WP5. Repo: github.com/Aaradhya-Dev-Tamrakar/BiasAperture, main. Scaffolding already committed (3ce9bf4): research/CONTEXT.md (system context, paste first in every session), research/RUNNER_GUIDE.md, research/track_01..20_*.md (per-track prompts), research/results/ (output target dir). SOP per user: paste CONTEXT.md, paste assigned track's Prompt section, save Claude's markdown output to research/results/<output_file>. 20 child tasks below, one per track/user, disjoint and independent. Constraint every track must respect: M1 locked schema (7 race groups, 2 gender groups, 9 age groups, n>=30 sample-size rule) — no track may propose changing it. No code/repo edits or sync.ps1 from any track — pure research, deliverable via submit_checkpoint result_text (or saved markdown path). Parent will merge_results once all 20 children are done, then a synthesis pass (same two-phase pattern as prior 8-track portfolio and 19-track SPARK research boards) feeds WP2-WP5 implementation.
